summary.zh-CN: 修复旧压缩会话的分段边界误判及摘要计算失败导致的会话锁死。
summary.en-US: Fix false part-boundary failures in older compacted sessions and summary failures locking durable conversations.

title.zh-CN: 正确处理部分消息视图

body.zh-CN: 修正部分预览的原始分段坐标和类型，旧派生索引自动从原 journal 重建，无需删除会话。原始正文保持不变。
body.en-US: Preserve original coordinates and part types in partial previews. Older derived indexes rebuild from the original journal without deleting conversations or rewriting original content.

body.zh-CN: 摘要计算失败不再误锁已成功写入的会话，诊断单独记录并随后续更新重试；真实写盘失败保护保留。原始事故首因仍在调查。
body.en-US: Summary failures are diagnosed separately and retried on later updates without locking a durably written conversation. Actual storage-failure protection remains. The original incident's first cause is still being investigated.
